sentences: Maximum weighted matching chooses disjoint edges with the greatest total weight.
The source asks for a streaming approximation arbitrarily close to optimal using \(O(n \log  n)\) space and a number of passes depending only on the accuracy.
It also raises the corresponding question of a linear-time approximation scheme in the RAM model.
Weighted improvement steps may require augmenting cycles, which are harder to locate through a stream than local edge exchanges.
This historical formulation focuses on whether those global improvements can be organized without storing the entire graph or making many passes.
